environment.description: Deployed in a Kubernetes pod with securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The pod spec includes securityContext.capabilities.drop: ['NET_RAW', 'SYS_ADMIN'] and runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000). An Istio sidecar proxy is injected with an EnvoyFilter that strips all response headers matching regex '^X-Decrypt-.*' before egress from the pod. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy enforces mTLS between services. Network policy restricts ingress to only the istio-ingressgateway namespace.

config.istio_authorization_policy: STRICT mTLS, allow only from istio-ingressgateway
